stepInstruction: Wait until the Migros orange splash screen appears.

condition.intent: Confirm the application has successfully launched and displayed the branding
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the Migros branding and orange theme are visible.

stepInstruction: Wait until the Migros main dashboard loads, displaying the service categories (Sanalmarket, Hemen, Yemek) and the search bar.

condition.intent: Confirm the app has navigated to the main menu where different shopping services can be selected
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the service icons like 'Migros Sanalmarket' and the top search bar are visible.

stepInstruction: Navigate to the Migros Sanalmarket service and click on the 'Categories' tab in the bottom navigation bar.

condition.intent: Confirm the user has successfully entered the category browsing view to select product types
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that category icons like 'Fruits, Vegetables' and 'Dairy, Breakfast Items' are visible.

stepInstruction: Search for 'Raffaello' using the top search bar and view the results.

condition.intent: Confirm the application successfully filtered products based on the search query
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that Raffaello products, such as 'Raffaello T24', are visible in the search results.

stepInstruction: Click the 'Add to Cart' button for the Ferrero Raffaello 150 G and wait for the delivery method selection.

condition.intent: Confirm that the application requires the user to select a delivery preference before adding the item to the cart
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the 'Choose Delivery Method' popup is visible with options for 'Deliver to My Address' and 'Order Pickup'.

stepInstruction: Select the 'Yurt' delivery address from the list to proceed with adding the item to the cart.

condition.intent: Confirm the address selection is complete and the user has been returned to the product view
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the 'Select Delivery Address' screen has closed and the Raffaello product page is visible again.

stepInstruction: Click on the 'Cart' icon in the top right corner to review the added items and proceed to checkout.

condition.intent: Confirm the user can see the list of items in their cart and the total price before confirming the order
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the Ferrero Raffaello is listed in the cart and the 'Confirm' button is visible at the bottom.

stepInstruction: Click the 'Confirm' button to proceed to the payment phase for the items in the cart.

condition.intent: Confirm the application transitions to the payment method selection after the cart is confirmed
condition.stepInstruction: Verify that the payment options or credit card entry fields are displayed.
